svg.title: Sharp minima lose to flat ones
svg.desc: Left: the effective potential along a valley U = a(u) + b(u) v²/2 whose deeper well at u = −1 is a hundred times sharper across the valley, for D = 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3. The log b term lifts the sharp well until, near D = 0.18, it is no longer a minimum. Right: the probability of the sharp basin against D, exact (the (D/2) log b correction), with the paper's D log b coefficient, and with no curvature term; a Langevin simulation at D = 0.15 sits on the exact curve.
